title: Erasure of Data on Devices Taken in Under Northbeam Renew Trade-In
content:
**Clause 1.** Every device taken in under Northbeam Renew Trade-In is sanitised before it leaves the retailer's hands, by one of the ways the Renew programme allows, and the method used is recorded against the serial.

**Clause 2.** A device the customer has already reset is still verified by the retailer, and a reset the retailer cannot verify counts as not wiped.

**Clause 3.** Where the programme issues an erasure certificate it is issued to the customer with the reference recorded. Within clause 3, the words *a business agreement is not closed out until every serial on the asset list carries one* are **no longer in force**, and when a business agreement is closed out is settled on the current basis for the Renew programme concerned; the certificate itself, and the recording of its reference, stand.

**Clause 4.** A device still locked to an account cannot be sanitised: it is either accepted at the locked deduction on the programmes that take locked devices, or sent back on those that do not.

**Clause 5.** A customer who declines sanitisation gets the device back, because the retailer does not resell a device carrying somebody's data.

**Points of judgement.**

| What the retailer finds | How it stands under these clauses |
| --- | --- |
| the customer reset the device and the retailer verifies the reset | wiped, by a way the programme allows |
| the customer reset the device and the retailer cannot verify the reset | not wiped |
| the device is still locked to an account, on a programme that takes locked devices | not sanitised; accepted at the locked deduction |
| the device is still locked to an account, on a programme that does not take locked devices | not sanitised; sent back |
| the customer declines sanitisation | the device goes back to the customer |

The recording under clause 1 is made against the serial, so a batch is sanitised serial by serial and the method used on each is the method recorded for it.

superseded_clauses: a business agreement is not closed out until every serial on the asset list carries one
